title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Repeal Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Repeal Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXVII OF 2020
ACT XXXVII OF 2020
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION
OF LOCAL COUNCILS (REPEAL) ACT, 2020
An Act to repeal the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Delimitation
of Local Councils Act, 2015
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
15th September, 2020]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-116 / 2020 / 6735, dated 15.9.2020.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local
Councils (Repeal) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 07th September, 2020 and assented to by the Governor of
the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 11th September, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
the Election Commission of Pakistan has been empowered to delimit the village
councils and neighbourhood councils for the elections of local councils in the
Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa under the Elections Act, 2017 (Act No.
XXXIII of 2017);
AND
WHEREAS pursuant to the above, the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local
Council Act, 2015 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. VI of 2015), has become redundant
and accordingly requires to be repealed;
It
is hereby enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as
follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils
(Repeal) Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
